subject: Music Production
title: Vaporwave and Ironic Sampling
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Vaporwave and Ironic Sampling.

hook.text: Vaporwave emerged online around 2010, slowing down 1980s pop and smooth jazz samples dramatically.

buildup.text: The slowed, chopped samples created a dreamy, surreal atmosphere dripping with nostalgia and irony.

discovery.text: Vaporwave used sampling as cultural commentary, critiquing consumerism and corporate music.

twist.text: The genre existed almost entirely online and was distributed free, avoiding copyright enforcement.

climax.text: Vaporwave proved that sampling could be a form of social criticism, not just music creation.

punchline.text: Slowing down pop music became an act of rebellion.

quiz.question: What was vaporwave's cultural purpose beyond music?
